current.summary: Sparse Markowitz Gauss-Jordan over F_n on the a=-3 IC relation matrix (2026-11-18): 136x129 to 1032x1025, 2.7-12x faster than the dense engine with 13-68x fewer touched entries and fill-in within ~5x of the input. At 1032x1025 (28-bit curve, fb=1024) sparse LA is 17.60 ms vs 57.85 ms dense and nnz_peak 21,379 vs 1,057,800. Every solve is verified end to end by [x]G = Q, and the sparse engine is checked against the dense one on the same relation set (rank, determined flags, values) and on planted-solution systems including a rank-deficient cell. Rank is computed once after collection, not recomputed per relation.

metrics.orbit_count_note: K = |F|; no orbit reduction applies on a generic-j a=-3 curve

metrics.rank_accumulation: solved once after collection; terminal rank 907-925 over 1025 columns (the target column is determined, the system is under-determined in the factor-base columns); not recomputed per relation
metrics.correctness: engine agreement on the same relation set and on planted-solution systems (12x8, 20x12, 10x12 rank-deficient, 40x40); every recorded solve recovers the known-answer scalar
